key_idea: Count how many white cubes there should be, then count the white cubes you can see.
steps: A 2 by 2 by 2 block has 8 cubes. Half are white, so 4 are white.
You can see 7 cubes. Only the bottom cube at the back left is hidden.
White cubes you can see: the top right and bottom left cubes on the front, and the top left cube at the back. That is 3.

choice_feedback.A: You can see only 3 white cubes, but there are 4.
choice_feedback.C: Only 1 cube is hidden in the whole block, so at most 1 white cube can be hidden.
choice_feedback.D: Only 1 cube is hidden in the whole block, so at most 1 white cube can be hidden.
choice_feedback.E: You can see 3 white cubes, so not all 4 are hidden.
